name: ai-bro
description: AI bro is a set of nine skills covering the full agent workflow — thinking, specification, planning, spec and plan review, implementation, code review, closing the work, and adaptable project knowledge. File-based specification and planning call /bro-review-spec-plan once, then close those findings without a second independent review. It adapts to your realities without imposing methodology. Includes a critical model tier for mandatory security reviews.
